instrument: O0 VERSUS O2 PAIRED LONG-HORIZON MATRIX

metricDefinitions.firstDivergenceDay: first differing production season boundary; daily first-divergence mediation is reported separately for the three required 200-year outliers
metricDefinitions.workerDaysAway: exact frontier-exploration party-workers multiplied by production departure-to-terminal duration, plus any still-active frontier journeys
metricDefinitions.provisions: frontier-exploration provisions loaded and consumed, from production journey records plus still-active frontier parties
metricDefinitions.receiptsAndSupport: receipts is the cumulative sum of fresh production receipt accumulators at season boundaries; support is the mean current-season raw support ratio across living band-season observations; terminal fields preserve the final current accumulator and rolling support
metricDefinitions.birthsAndDeaths: cumulative production annual lastBirths/lastDeaths, counted once per band and demographic-update tick
